definitions.gloss: living for the moment; momentary; heedless of the future
definitions.explanation: Seeking only the pleasure or satisfaction of the present moment, with no thought for what comes after. Usually critical.

examples.japanese: {刹那的|せつなてき}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧。
examples.english: A way of life that lives only for the moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刹那的|せつなてき}な⟦{快楽|かいらく}→快楽：27770_kairaku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: He seeks nothing but momentary pleasures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}てない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{刹那的|せつなてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some young people who see no hope in the future live only for the moment.

notes:
⟦{刹那|せつな}→刹那：15537_setsuna⟧ (an instant, from the Sanskrit for the smallest unit of time) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. A written, somewhat literary word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刹那的|せつなてき}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧: living for the moment
- {刹那的|せつなてき}な⟦{快楽|かいらく}→快楽：27770_kairaku⟧: momentary pleasures
- {刹那的|せつなてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live only for the present

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {享楽的|きょうらくてき}: pleasure-seeking; {刹那的|せつなてき} stresses the lack of thought for the future
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{日暮|ひぐ}らし: living from day to day, usually because of money
